description: Create a new SLD style in GeoServer named 'river_buffer' that dynamically renders a buffered area around line features. The buffer distance must be 0.1 degrees. Use a red fill (#FF0000) with 0.5 opacity for the polygon symbolizer. Assign this new style to the 'ne:ne_rivers' layer in the 'ne' workspace. You can access the GeoServer admin interface at http://localhost:8080/geoserver/web/ (User: admin, Password: Admin123!).
